setup_instructions: Do NOT run npm install/ci in the sandbox - npm registry is firewalled (403/ENOTCACHED). node_modules is present but lacks CLI binaries. The deploy uses nixpacks.toml [phases.install] cmds=["npm install --legacy-peer-deps"] and CI uses the same; do NOT break those workarounds.
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no external network, no npm install, no package-lock regeneration in-sandbox, no dev server, no web fetch. package-lock.json is ALREADY out of sync with package.json (react pinned to ~19.2) and CANNOT be regenerated here; if deps are removed from package.json, the lockfile must be regenerated on a networked machine - note this in the summary. Do NOT run npm install.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: repo syncs to Lovable - NEVER force-push/rebase/amend/squash pushed commits; keep branch working. Work on branch rebuild/immersive-3d (do NOT create a new branch, do NOT push - orchestrator pushes). Open PR #11 targets main.
key_patterns: SSR safety is paramount: no window/document access during render/SSR - all DOM access lives behind useEffect or `typeof window` guards (see src/lib/motion.ts). Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion everywhere (both JS gates via useReducedMotion/prefersReducedMotion and a CSS guard block at styles.css ~line 3591 that neutralises [class*="immersive-"]). Scroll/pointer listeners are registered `{ passive: true }`. Scroll-driven work is coalesced into one requestAnimationFrame per frame. WCAG AA focus-visible styles (e.g. .cinema-service-item:focus-visible) must remain.
